homepageTopArticles.title: Shein expands U.S. fulfillment network with 737,000-square-foot Indiana warehouse
homepageTopArticles.snippet:
Less than two weeks after Shein’s initial public offering in Hong Kong, the online marketplace that made its name in fashion opened the doors to a new warehouse in Lebanon, Indiana. Shein’s latest distribution warehouse in the U.S. measures 737,000 square feet, according to the company’s official announcement. The heavily automated facility marks an expansion […]
The post Shein expands U.S. fulfillment network with 737,000-square-foot Indiana warehouse appeared first on Digital Commerce 360.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Shein opened a 737,000-square-foot automated warehouse in Lebanon, Indiana, expanding its U.S. fulfillment network less than two weeks after its Hong Kong IPO.

homepageTopArticles.title: Walmart adds marketplace data, deeper AI features to Scintilla insights platform
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Walmart's first-party data platform for merchants and suppliers, Scintilla, is getting a big upgrade next year, the company announced at Walmart Data Ventures’ Inspire conference this week.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Walmart will upgrade its Scintilla data platform in 2027 with marketplace data and enhanced AI features for merchants and suppliers.

homepageTopArticles.title: Modest sales slide for diamond jewellery retail giant
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Diamond jewellery retail giant Signet Jewelers has reported a decline in sales during the second quarter of the financial year.
